integration_issues.flow: Usage time tracking per person (stats screen)
integration_issues.issue: Inverted attribution in commitUsage (index.tsx:205-225): elapsed time of the PREVIOUS segment is credited to the INCOMING residentId. Opening a profile credits home-screen time to that resident; leaving the profile/workshop credits the 6+s actually spent there to nobody (total only). Observed: after >6s in TEST_Marcel's workshop, stats-row showed only '3 s' (the pre-profile segment) while global total correctly grew. Acceptance criterion 'per-person time > 0 s' passes but for the wrong reason. Fix: attribute elapsed to usageSession.current.residentId (the outgoing segment) BEFORE overwriting it with the new residentId.

rca_of_issue: Bug: per-person usage time wrong. Reproduction: create resident, open profile -> workshop, wait >5s, back to home, open stats. Expected: stats-row for that resident >=5s. Actual: row shows only the small pre-profile segment (3s); workshop time goes to total only. Root cause: commitUsage(residentId) computes elapsed for the segment that just ENDED but credits it to the NEWLY passed residentId instead of usageSession.current.residentId (the segment owner). Mitigation: const owner = usageSession.current.residentId; ... by_resident[owner] += elapsed before assigning the new residentId.
